mechanism: On the first history dialog open after launch, queryHistoriesByDate resolves four invariant column indices per row and inserts each decoded row at the front of a growing array.
fix_summary: Resolve column indices once per result set, append decoded rows, then reverse once to preserve the displayed order.

performance_oracle.definition: App-process retired instructions during the fixed 60-second measured step that opens history and waits for Article 29999. Setup and result verification run outside the profile.
performance_oracle.comparison: Median unfixed >= 1.2 * median fixed across at least three paired rounds.
performance_oracle.workload_notes: Use seed_browser.py Histories.db --days 1 --per-day 30000. Reset to the same database and force-stop before each round. Verify the newest record is displayed first. No app-internal driver or counter.
